title: Data Processing Addendum (U.S.)
description: Processor-friendly DPA for U.S. personal data with security measures and state-privacy-law compliance.
when_needed: When you process U.S. personal data for customers and need a processor-friendly DPA.

fields.label: Company name
fields.question: What is the processor company's name?

fields.label: Customer agreement name
fields.question: What is the name of the main customer agreement this DPA attaches to?

fields.label: Effective date
fields.question: What is the effective date of the customer agreement?

fields.label: Data protection contact
fields.question: What role or team handles data protection questions (for example, Privacy Team)?

fields.label: Data protection email
fields.question: What email should data protection questions go to?

fields.label: Company description
fields.question: Briefly describe the company and the processing it performs.

fields.label: Subprocessor list
fields.question: Where can customers find your subprocessors (for example, Annex 4 or a URL)?
